<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>وجهني - الملاحة التكتيكية ثلاثية الأبعاد</title>
  <script src="https://www.gstatic.com/antigravity/web/dev/tailwindcss.min.js"></script>
  <script type="module" src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/model-viewer/3.4.0/model-viewer.min.js"></script>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Tajawal:wght@300;400;500;700;900&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap');
    
    * {
      font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }
    
    .font-mono-tactical {
      font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
    }

    /* Tactical Glows & Gradients */
    .glow-cyan {
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45);
    }
    .glow-emerald {
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 133, 0.45);
    }
    .glow-gold {
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 184, 0, 0.45);
    }
    .glow-purple {
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45);
    }
    .text-glow-cyan {
      text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.7);
    }
    .border-glow-cyan {
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25), 0 0 10px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.3);
    }

    /* Tactical HUD Grid Overlay */
    .hud-grid {
      background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
                        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 24px 24px;
    }

    /* Custom Scrollbar */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: #0B0F19;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: #1E293B;
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: #00F0FF;
    }

    /* Radar sweep animation */
    @keyframes radarSweep {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    .radar-sweep-arm {
      animation: radarSweep 3.2s linear infinite;
      transform-origin: center;
    }

    /* Pulse animation */
    @keyframes pulseRing {
      0% { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0.9; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 0.4; }
      100% { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0.9; }
    }
    .pulse-tactical {
      animation: pulseRing 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-[#070A12] text-slate-100 min-h-screen flex flex-col select-none overflow-x-hidden">

  <!-- TOP STATUS BAR & HEADER -->
  <header class="bg-[#0B0F19]/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-cyan-500/20 px-4 py-3 sticky top-0 z-40">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
      
      <!-- Brand & Tactical Badge -->
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-500 to-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center glow-cyan border border-cyan-400/50">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-location-crosshairs text-slate-950 text-xl font-bold"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 class="font-bold text-lg text-white tracking-wide">وجهني <span class="text-cyan-400 font-mono-tactical text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-950/80 border border-cyan-500/40">3D HUD</span></h1>
            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono-tactical text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-950/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/30">
              <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping"></span>
              ملاحة نشطة
            </span>
          </div>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 hidden sm:block">النظام التكتيكي لإرشاد الحرم الجامعي | المنظور الأول 3D ورادار UWB</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Quick Telemetry & Actions -->
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 flex-wrap">
        
        <!-- Live Azimuth Compass Chip -->
        <button onclick="toggleRadarModal()" class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#121929] hover:bg-[#1A2338] border border-cyan-500/30 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-all group">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-compass text-cyan-400 group-hover:rotate-45 transition-transform duration-300"></i>
          <span class="font-mono-tactical text-cyan-300" id="headerAzimuth">318° NW</span>
          <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 hidden md:inline">| رادار</span>
        </button>

        <!-- UWB Precision Indicator -->
        <div class="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#121929] border border-emerald-500/30 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono-tactical text-emerald-400">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-satellite-dish text-[10px]"></i>
          <span>UWB ±0.35m</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Audio Mute / Unmute Toggle -->
        <button onclick="toggleVoiceMute()" id="muteBtn" class="bg-[#121929] hover:bg-[#1A2338] border border-slate-700 hover:border-cyan-500/50 text-slate-300 hover:text-cyan-300 w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm transition-all" title="كتم / تفعيل الصوت التكتيكي">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i>
        </button>

        <!-- Download APK Button -->
        <a href="Wajehni-Tactical-3D.apk" download class="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-500 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs flex items-center gap-2 glow-emerald transition-all shadow-lg hover:scale-105 active:scale-95" title="تحميل ملف APK مباشرة لجوال الأندرويد">
          <i class="fa-brands fa-android text-sm"></i>
          <span>تحميل APK (27MB)</span>
        </a>

      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- MAIN VIEWPORT CONTAINER -->
  <main class="flex-1 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full p-3 sm:p-4 md:p-6 flex flex-col gap-4">
    
    <!-- SYSTEM NOTICE / STATUS BANNER -->
    <div id="statusBanner" class="bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-950/60 via-[#0E172A] to-blue-950/60 border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-md">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
        <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse"></span>
        <span class="text-slate-300" id="bannerMessage">النظام التكتيكي جاهز - حدد قاعة من الدليل أو انقر فوق أي مبنى في المشهد ثلاثي الأبعاد لبدء الهبوط والملاحة.</span>
      </div>
      <button onclick="dismissBanner()" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white px-2 py-1 rounded transition-colors">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- TACTICAL SCREENS WRAPPER -->
    <div class="flex-1 relative min-h-[580px]">

      <!-- ============================================== -->
      <!-- SCREEN 1: CAMPUS 3D SCENE (الحرم 3D) -->
      <!-- ============================================== -->
      <div id="screen-campus3d" class="screen-view h-full flex flex-col gap-4">
        
        <!-- Controls Toolbar -->
        <div class="bg-[#0E1526] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-md">
          
          <!-- Floor Filter Chips -->
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-1 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group text-cyan-400"></i>
              <span>الأدوار:</span>
            </span>
            <button onclick="setFloorFilter(null)" class="floor-chip active bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs transition-all">الكل</button>
            <button onclick="setFloorFilter(0)" class="floor-chip bg-[#162035] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs transition-all">الأرضي</button>
            <button onclick="setFloorFilter(1)" class="floor-chip bg-[#162035] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs transition-all">الأول</button>
            <button onclick="setFloorFilter(2)" class="floor-chip bg-[#162035] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs transition-all">الثاني</button>
            <button onclick="setFloorFilter(3)" class="floor-chip bg-[#162035] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs transition-all">الثالث</button>
            <button onclick="setFloorFilter(4)" class="floor-chip bg-[#162035] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs transition-all">الرابع</button>
          </div>

          <!-- Quick Toggles -->
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button onclick="toggleGlbModelView()" id="glbToggleBtn" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#121B30] hover:bg-[#1A2744] text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-all" title="عرض نموذج الحرم الجامعي 3D المرفوع">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-cube text-[10px]"></i>
              <span>نموذج GLB الحقيقي</span>
            </button>
            <button onclick="toggleIotOverlay()" id="iotToggleBtn" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#121B30] hover:bg-[#1A2744] text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-all">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-wifi text-[10px]"></i>
              <span>مؤشرات IoT</span>
            </button>
            <button onclick="toggleWheelchairMode()" id="wheelchairToggleBtn" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#121B30] hover:bg-[#1A2744] text-slate-300 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-all">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-wheelchair text-[11px]"></i>
              <span>مسارات الكراسي</span>
            </button>
            <button onclick="reset3DCamera()" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#121B30] hover:bg-[#1A2744] text-slate-300 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-all" title="إعادة ضبط زاوية الرؤية">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-arrows-rotate text-[10px]"></i>
              <span>إعادة ضبط</span>
            </button>
          </div>

        </div>

        <!-- 3D Canvas Area & Info Sidebar Grid -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 flex-1">
          
          <!-- 3D Viewport Box -->
          <div class="lg:col-span-3 relative bg-[#090D18] border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col min-h-[460px]">
            <canvas id="campusCanvas" class="w-full h-full cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing flex-1"></canvas>
            
            <!-- Real Uploaded GLB Model Viewer -->
            <model-viewer id="glbCampusViewer" src="data:model/gltf-binary;base64," alt="نموذج الحرم الجامعي ثلاثي الأبعاد" style="min-height: 460px; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: none;" camera-orbit="35deg 60deg 145m" exposure="1.2" camera-controls auto-rotate shadow-intensity="1" ar></model-viewer>
            
            <!-- Canvas HUD Overlays -->
            <div class="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-[#0B1020]/80 backdrop-blur border border-cyan-500/30 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-mono-tactical text-cyan-300 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-ping"></span>
              <span>GRID-3D: 12 BLDGS | ACTIVE</span>
            </div>

            <!-- Compass Widget on Canvas -->
            <div class="absolute bottom-3 right-3 bg-[#0B1020]/90 backdrop-blur border border-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3 text-xs">
              <div class="relative w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-cyan-500/50 flex items-center justify-center">
                <i id="canvasCompassArrow" class="fa-solid fa-location-arrow text-cyan-400 text-sm transition-transform duration-200" style="transform: rotate(-45deg);"></i>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">الاتجاه اللحظي</div>
                <div id="canvasAzimuthLabel" class="font-mono-tactical font-bold text-cyan-300 text-xs">318° NW</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Drag Instruction Hint -->
            <div class="absolute bottom-3 left-3 bg-[#0B1020]/80 backdrop-blur border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 pointer-events-none">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-hand-pointer text-cyan-400"></i>
              <span>اسحب للتدوير 360° | استخدم العجلة للتكبير</span>
            </div>

          </div>

          <!-- Building Details & Quick Action Panel -->
          <div class="lg:col-span-1 bg-[#0E1526] border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-xl">
            <div class="space-y-4">
              
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
                <span class="text-xs font-mono-tactical text-cyan-400 uppercase tracking-widest">تفاصيل المبنى</span>
                <span id="bldgIdBadge" class="bg-cyan-950 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 text-[10px] font-mono-tactical px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold">BLDG-01</span>
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 id="bldgTitle" class="text-base font-bold text-white mb-1">مبنى 1</h3>
                <p id="bldgDesc" class="text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">مبنى 1 في الحرم الجامعي</p>
              </div>

              <!-- Stats Grid -->
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                <div class="bg-[#131C31] p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <div class="text-slate-400 text-[10px] mb-0.5">عدد الأدوار</div>
                  <div id="bldgFloors" class="font-mono-tactical font-bold text-cyan-400 text-sm">4 أدوار</div>
                </div>
                <div class="bg-[#131C31] p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <div class="text-slate-400 text-[10px] mb-0.5">البوابات الذكية</div>
                  <div id="bldgEntrances" class="font-mono-tactical font-bold text-emerald-400 text-sm">2 بوابات</div>
                </div>
                <div class="bg-[#131C31] p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <div class="text-slate-400 text-[10px] mb-0.5">كثافة الحشود</div>
                  <div id="bldgCrowd" class="font-mono-tactical font-bold text-gold-400 text-amber-400 text-sm">42% متوسطة</div>
                </div>
                <div class="bg-[#131C31] p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <div class="text-slate-400 text-[10px] mb-0.5">توفير الطاقة IoT</div>
                  <div id="bldgEnergy" class="font-mono-tactical font-bold text-emerald-400 text-sm">34% نشط</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Featured Target Hall in Building -->
              <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-950/40 to-blue-950/40 border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-xl p-3">
                <div class="text-[10px] text-cyan-400 font-semibold mb-1">الهدف المميز الحالي:</div>
                <div class="font-bold text-white text-xs mb-0.5" id="bldgFeaturedHallName">قاعة المؤتمرات الكبرى (#402)</div>
                <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400" id="bldgFeaturedHallDetail">الدور الرابع • السعة 250 مقعداً • متاح</div>
              </div>

            </div>

            <!-- Action Button: Launch Aerial Drop & Navigate -->
            <button onclick="launchAerialDropForCurrentBuilding()" class="w-full mt-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-400 hover:to-blue-500 text-slate-950 font-bold py-3 px-4 rounded-xl text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 glow-cyan transition-all shadow-lg active:scale-98">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-jet-fighter-up text-base"></i>
              <span>هبوط تكتيكي وملاحة فورية</span>
            </button>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- ============================================== -->
      <!-- SCREEN 2: DIRECTORY SCREEN (دليل القاعات) -->
      <!-- ============================================== -->
      <div id="screen-directory" class="screen-view hidden h-full flex flex-col gap-4">
        
        <!-- Search & Filter Controls -->
        <div class="bg-[#0E1526] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-md">
          
          <!-- Search Input Box -->
          <div class="relative w-full sm:w-80">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 text-xs"></i>
            <input type="text" id="dirSearchInput" oninput="filterHalls()" placeholder="ابحث برقم القاعة (مثلاً 402) أو التخصص..." class="w-full bg-[#141C30] border border-slate-700 focus:border-cyan-400 rounded-lg pr-9 pl-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none transition-colors">
          </div>

          <!-- Category Chips -->
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button onclick="setDirCategory('ALL')" class="dir-chip active bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-all">الكل</button>
            <button onclick="setDirCategory('CONFERENCES')" class="dir-chip bg-[#141C30] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-all">مؤتمرات</button>
            <button onclick="setDirCategory('TECH_AI')" class="dir-chip bg-[#141C30] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-all">حاسب وذكاء اصطناعي</button>
            <button onclick="setDirCategory('AUDITORIUMS')" class="dir-chip bg-[#141C30] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-all">مدرجات</button>
            <button onclick="setDirCategory('FINANCE_ADMIN')" class="dir-chip bg-[#141C30] text-slate-300 hover:text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-all">مالية وإدارة</button>
          </div>

        </div>

        <!-- Halls Cards Grid -->
        <div id="hallsContainer" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 overflow-y-auto max-h-[580px] p-1">
          <!-- Dynamically populated via JS -->
        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- ============================================== -->
      <!-- SCREEN 3: 3D INDOOR WALKTHROUGH (الملاحة 3D) -->
      <!-- ============================================== -->
      <div id="screen-walkthrough" class="screen-view hidden h-full flex flex-col gap-4">
        
        <!-- Walkthrough HUD Header -->
        <div class="bg-[#0E1526] border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-md">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-cyan-950 border border-cyan-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400 font-mono-tactical font-bold text-sm" id="walkHallCodeBadge">
              #402
            </div>
            <div>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 class="font-bold text-white text-sm" id="walkHallTitle">قاعة الشيخ صالح الفهد للمؤتمرات</h3>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-mono-tactical text-cyan-400 bg-cyan-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-cyan-500/30" id="walkFloorBadge">الدور 4</span>
              </div>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-400" id="walkBuildingName">مبنى 1 - كلية الهندسة والعلوم التطبيقية</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <!-- Continuous Walk Toggle -->
            <button onclick="toggleContinuousWalk()" id="walkSimBtn" class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-500 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs glow-emerald transition-all shadow">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-person-walking text-sm"></i>
              <span id="walkSimBtnText">تشغيل محاكي المشي المستمر</span>
            </button>

            <!-- AR Camera Mode Toggle -->
            <button onclick="toggleArMode()" id="arModeBtn" class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#141C30] hover:bg-[#1C2742] text-slate-300 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-all">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-camera text-xs"></i>
              <span>وضع AR</span>
            </button>

            <!-- Speak Audio Instruction -->
            <button onclick="speakCurrentStepAudio()" class="bg-[#141C30] hover:bg-cyan-950 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/40 w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm transition-all" title="استمع للإرشاد الصوتي">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 3D Corridor Perspective Canvas View -->
        <div class="relative bg-[#070A12] border border-cyan-500/40 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col h-[380px]">
          <canvas id="corridorCanvas" class="w-full h-full flex-1"></canvas>
          
          <!-- Tactical HUD Corner Graphics -->
          <div class="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-[#0B1020]/80 backdrop-blur border border-cyan-500/30 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono-tactical text-cyan-300 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-ping"></span>
            <span>UWB TELEMETRY: LOCK ±0.35m</span>
          </div>

          <!-- AR Mode Simulation Overlay -->
          <div id="arOverlay" class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none hidden bg-emerald-950/15 border-2 border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <div class="w-48 h-48 border border-dashed border-emerald-400/50 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center animate-spin" style="animation-duration: 20s;">
              <div class="w-32 h-32 border border-emerald-400/40 rounded-full"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="absolute bottom-4 bg-[#0B1020]/90 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-mono-tactical">
              AR SCANNER: CORRIDOR DOORS DETECTED
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Step Progression HUD Bar -->
          <div class="absolute bottom-3 inset-x-3 bg-[#0B1020]/90 backdrop-blur border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">

    /* ==============================================================
       APP STATE
       ============================================================== */
    let currentBuilding = CAMPUS_BUILDINGS[0];
    let activeHall = CAMPUS_HALLS[0];
    let selectedFloorFilter = null;
    let showIotOverlay = true;
    let wheelchairOnly = false;
    let isVoiceMuted = false;
    let bookedHallCodes = new Set();
    let currentStepIndex = 2; // Default to step 3 in corridor
    let isContinuousWalking = false;
    let walkIntervalId = null;
    let isArMode = false;
    let corridorYaw = 0;
    let corridorProgress = 0.45; // 0.0 to 1.0 within current step
    let aerialAltitude = 280;
    let aerialIntervalId = null;

    /* Web Audio Sound Synthesizer */
    let audioCtx = null;
    function playTacticalBeep(freq = 880, type = 'sine', duration = 0.08) {
      if (isVoiceMuted) return;
      try {
        if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
        const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
        const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
        osc.type = type;
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, audioCtx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Audio Context init suppressed", e);
      }
    }

    /* Speech Synthesis Helper */
    function speakArabicText(text) {
      if (isVoiceMuted || !('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
      try {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
        utterance.lang = 'ar-SA';
        utterance.rate = 1.0;
        utterance.pitch = 1.0;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Speech synthesis error", e);
      }
    }

    /* ==============================================================
       CANVAS 1: 3D CAMPUS INTERACTIVE ENGINE
       ============================================================== */
    const campusCanvas = document.getElementById('campusCanvas');
    const cCtx = campusCanvas.getContext('2d');
    let camYaw = -0.55; // Radians
    let camPitch = 0.65; // Radians
    let camZoom = 1.0;
    let isDragging = false;
    let lastMouseX = 0;
    let lastMouseY = 0;

    function resizeCampusCanvas() {
      const rect = campusCanvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      campusCanvas.width = rect.width;
      campusCanvas.height = rect.height;
      drawCampusScene();
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCampusCanvas);

    campusCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      lastMouseX = e.clientX;
      lastMouseY = e.clientY;
    });
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDragging = false; });
    campusCanvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const dx = e.clientX - lastMouseX;
      const dy = e.clientY - lastMouseY;
      camYaw += dx * 0.008;
      camPitch = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1.3, camPitch + dy * 0.008));
      lastMouseX = e.clientX;
      lastMouseY = e.clientY;
      updateCompassHeading();
      drawCampusScene();
    });

    campusCanvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      camZoom = Math.max(0.6, Math.min(2.0, camZoom - e.deltaY * 0.0015));
      drawCampusScene();
    }, { passive: false });

    // Touch support for mobile phones
    campusCanvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
      if (e.touches.length === 1) {
        isDragging = true;
        lastMouseX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        lastMouseY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      }
    });
    campusCanvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
      const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - lastMouseX;
      const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - lastMouseY;
      camYaw += dx * 0.01;
      camPitch = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1.3, camPitch + dy * 0.01));
      lastMouseX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      lastMouseY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      updateCompassHeading();
      drawCampusScene();
    });
    campusCanvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { isDragging = false; });

    // Project 3D point (x, y, z) to 2D canvas coordinates
    function project3D(x, y, z, cx, cy) {
      // Rotate around Y axis (yaw)
      const cosY = Math.cos(camYaw);
      const sinY = Math.sin(camYaw);
      const x1 = x * cosY - z * sinY;
      const z1 = x * sinY + z * cosY;

      // Rotate around X axis (pitch)
      const cosP = Math.cos(camPitch);
      const sinP = Math.sin(camPitch);
      const y2 = y * cosP - z1 * sinP;
      const z2 = y * sinP + z1 * cosP;

      const scale = (350 / (350 + z2 * 0.35)) * camZoom;
      return {
        x: cx + x1 * scale,
        y: cy - y2 * scale,
        depth: z2
      };
    }

    function drawCampusScene() {
      if (!campusCanvas.width || !campusCanvas.height) return;
      const w = campusCanvas.width;
      const h = campusCanvas.height;
      const cx = w / 2;
      const cy = h / 2 + 30;

      // Background clear
      cCtx.fillStyle = '#080C16';
      cCtx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

      // Draw Ground Tactical Grid
      cCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.07)';
      cCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      const gridSize = 450;
      const step = 45;

      for (let i = -gridSize; i <= gridSize; i += step) {
        const p1 = project3D(i, 0, -gridSize, cx, cy);
        const p2 = project3D(i, 0, gridSize, cx, cy);
        cCtx.beginPath();
        cCtx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
        cCtx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
        cCtx.stroke();

        const p3 = project3D(-gridSize, 0, i, cx, cy);
        const p4 = project3D(gridSize, 0, i, cx, cy);
        cCtx.beginPath();
        cCtx.moveTo(p3.x, p3.y);
        cCtx.lineTo(p4.x, p4.y);
        cCtx.stroke();
      }

      // Draw Pedestrian Pathways between buildings
      cCtx.strokeStyle = wheelchairOnly ? 'rgba(0, 255, 133, 0.5)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)';
      cCtx.lineWidth = wheelchairOnly ? 3 : 2;
      cCtx.setLineDash([6, 4]);

      // Connect central hub to perimeter buildings
      CAMPUS_BUILDINGS.forEach((b) => {
        const center = project3D(0, 2, 5, cx, cy);
        const bPos = project3D(b.x, 2, b.z, cx, cy);
        cCtx.beginPath();
        cCtx.moveTo(center.x, center.y);
        cCtx.lineTo(bPos.x, bPos.y);
        cCtx.stroke();
      });
      cCtx.setLineDash([]);

      // Sort buildings by depth for proper painter's algorithm rendering
      const sorted = [...CAMPUS_BUILDINGS].sort((a, b) => {
        const az = a.x * Math.sin(camYaw) + a.z * Math.cos(camYaw);
        const bz = b.x * Math.sin(camYaw) + b.z * Math.cos(camYaw);
        return az - bz; // Far to near
      });

      // Render Each 3D Building Box
      sorted.forEach((b) => {
        drawBuilding3D(b, cx, cy);
      });
    }

    function drawBuilding3D(b, cx, cy) {
      const isSelected = currentBuilding.id === b.id;
      const hw = b.w / 2;
      const hd = b.d / 2;
      
      // Determine effective building height based on floor filter
      let effectiveHeight = b.h;
      if (selectedFloorFilter !== null) {
        effectiveHeight = (selectedFloorFilter + 1) * (b.h / b.floors);
      }

      // 8 Vertices of the 3D cuboid
      const v = [
        project3D(b.x - hw, 0, b.z - hd, cx, cy),                 // 0: Bottom-rear-left
        project3D(b.x + hw, 0, b.z - hd, cx, cy),                 // 1: Bottom-rear-right
        project3D(b.x + hw, 0, b.z + hd, cx, cy),                 // 2: Bottom-front-right
        project3D(b.x - hw, 0, b.z + hd, cx, cy),                 // 3: Bottom-front-left
        project3D(b.x - hw, effectiveHeight, b.z - hd, cx, cy),   // 4: Top-rear-left
        project3D(b.x + hw, effectiveHeight, b.z - hd, cx, cy),   // 5: Top-rear-right
        project3D(b.x + hw, effectiveHeight, b.z + hd, cx, cy),   // 6: Top-front-right
        project3D(b.x - hw, effectiveHeight, b.z + hd, cx, cy)    // 7: Top-front-left
      ];

      // Roof polygon (4, 5, 6, 7)
      cCtx.beginPath();
      cCtx.moveTo(v[4].x, v[4].y);
      cCtx.lineTo(v[5].x, v[5].y);
      cCtx.lineTo(v[6].x, v[6].y);
      cCtx.lineTo(v[7].x, v[7].y);
      cCtx.closePath();
      cCtx.fillStyle = isSelected ? 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45)' : 'rgba(20, 32, 54, 0.9)';
      cCtx.fill();
      cCtx.strokeStyle = isSelected ? '#00F0FF' : b.color;
      cCtx.lineWidth = isSelected ? 2.5 : 1.2;
      cCtx.stroke();

      // Front / Side Faces
      const faces = [
        [3, 2, 6, 7], // Front
        [2, 1, 5, 6], // Right
        [0, 3, 7, 4], // Left
      ];

      faces.forEach(face => {
        cCtx.beginPath();
        cCtx.moveTo(v[face[0]].x, v[face[0]].y);
        cCtx.lineTo(v[face[1]].x, v[face[1]].y);
        cCtx.lineTo(v[face[2]].x, v[face[2]].y);
        cCtx.lineTo(v[face[3]].x, v[face[3]].y);
        cCtx.closePath();
        cCtx.fillStyle = isSelected ? 'rgba(0, 180, 240, 0.25)' : 'rgba(12, 20, 36, 0.85)';
        cCtx.fill();
        cCtx.strokeStyle = isSelected ? 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.7)' : 'rgba(40, 60, 95, 0.6)';
        cCtx.lineWidth = 1;
        cCtx.stroke();
      });

      // Roof Beacon / IoT Signal Pulse
      if (showIotOverlay) {
        const topCenter = project3D(b.x, effectiveHeight + 6, b.z, cx, cy);
        cCtx.beginPath();
        cCtx.arc(topCenter.x, topCenter.y, isSelected ? 6 : 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        cCtx.fillStyle = b.color;
        cCtx.fill();

        // Pulsing ring
        cCtx.beginPath();
        cCtx.arc(topCenter.x, topCenter.y, isSelected ? 12 : 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        cCtx.strokeStyle = b.color;
        cCtx.lineWidth = 1;
        cCtx.stroke();
      }

      // Building Label on Canvas
      const labelPos = project3D(b.x, effectiveHeight + 14, b.z, cx, cy);
      cCtx.fillStyle = isSelected ? '#00F0FF' : '#E2E8F0';
      cCtx.font = isSelected ? 'bold 11px Tajawal, sans-serif' : '10px Tajawal, sans-serif';
      cCtx.textAlign = 'center';
      cCtx.fillText(b.title, labelPos.x, labelPos.y);

      // Occupancy Badge if IoT is enabled
      if (showIotOverlay) {
        cCtx.fillStyle = b.crowd > 50 ? '#F59E0B' : '#00FF85';
        cCtx.font = '9px monospace';
        cCtx.fillText(`${b.crowd}% حشود`, labelPos.x, labelPos.y + 11);
      }
    }

    // Click Detection on Campus Buildings
    campusCanvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const rect = campusCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const cx = campusCanvas.width / 2;
      const cy = campusCanvas.height / 2 + 30;

      for (const b of CAMPUS_BUILDINGS) {
        const top = project3D(b.x, b.h / 2, b.z, cx, cy);
        const dist = Math.hypot(clickX - top.x, clickY - top.y);
        if (dist < 40) {
          selectBuilding(b);
          playTacticalBeep(700, 'triangle', 0.06);
          break;
        }
      }
    });

    function selectBuilding(b) {
      currentBuilding = b;
      document.getElementById('bldgIdBadge').textContent = `BLDG-0${b.id}`;
      document.getElementById('bldgTitle').textContent = b.official;
      document.getElementById('bldgDesc').textContent = b.desc;
      document.getElementById('bldgFloors').textContent = `${b.floors} أدوار`;
      document.getElementById('bldgEntrances').textContent = `${b.entrances} بوابات`;
      document.getElementById('bldgCrowd').textContent = `${b.crowd}% ${b.crowd > 50 ? 'عالية' : 'معتدلة'}`;
      document.getElementById('bldgEnergy').textContent = `${b.energy}% نشط`;
      document.getElementById('bldgFeaturedHallName').textContent = b.featuredHall;
      
      // Update banner notification
      updateBanner(`تم تحديد: ${b.official} | انقر فوق "هبوط تكتيكي" لبدء التجربة الملاحية.`);
      drawCampusScene();
    }

    function updateCompassHeading() {
      // Calculate azimuth based on camYaw
      let deg = Math.round((-camYaw * (180 / Math.PI)) % 360);
      if (deg < 0) deg += 360;
      
      const directions = ['N', 'NE', 'E', 'SE', 'S', 'SW', 'W', 'NW'];
      const dirIndex = Math.round(deg / 45) % 8;
      const label = `${deg}° ${directions[dirIndex]}`;

      document.getElementById('headerAzimuth').textContent = label;
      document.getElementById('canvasAzimuthLabel').textContent = label;
      document.getElementById('radarAzimuthDisplay').textContent = label;
      document.getElementById('canvasCompassArrow').style.transform = `rotate(${deg - 45}deg)`;
    }

    function reset3DCamera() {
      camYaw = -0.55;
      camPitch = 0.65;
      camZoom = 1.0;
      updateCompassHeading();
      drawCampusScene();
      playTacticalBeep(600, 'sine', 0.05);
    }

    function setFloorFilter(floor) {
      selectedFloorFilter = floor;
      document.querySelectorAll('.floor-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-slate-950', 'font-bold'));
      const activeBtn = event.target;
      activeBtn.classList.add('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-slate-950', 'font-bold');
      drawCampusScene();
      playTacticalBeep(750, 'sine', 0.04);
    }

    function toggleIotOverlay() {
      showIotOverlay = !showIotOverlay;
      const btn = document.getElementById('iotToggleBtn');
      if (showIotOverlay) {
        btn.classList.add('text-cyan-300', 'border-cyan-500/40');
        btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400', 'border-slate-700');
      } else {
        btn.classList.remove('text-cyan-300', 'border-cyan-500/40');
        btn.classList.add('text-slate-400', 'border-slate-700');
      }
      drawCampusScene();
      playTacticalBeep(850, 'sine', 0.04);
    }

    function toggleWheelchairMode() {
      wheelchairOnly = !wheelchairOnly;
      const btn = document.getElementById('wheelchairToggleBtn');
      if (wheelchairOnly) {
        btn.classList.add('text-emerald-400', 'border-emerald-500/40', 'glow-emerald');
        btn.classList.remove('text-slate-300', 'border-slate-700');
        updateBanner("تم تفعيل فلتر مسارات الكراسي المتحركة: جميع المسارات الموضحة خالية تماماً من الدرج.");
      } else {
        btn.classList.remove('text-emerald-400', 'border-emerald-500/40', 'glow-emerald');
        btn.classList.add('text-slate-300', 'border-slate-700');
        updateBanner("تم إلغاء فلتر مسارات الكراسي المتحركة.");
      }
      drawCampusScene();
      playTacticalBeep(800, 'sine', 0.04);
    }

    let isGlbModelActive = false;
    function toggleGlbModelView() {
      isGlbModelActive = !isGlbModelActive;
      const canvas = document.getElementById('campusCanvas');
      const glbViewer = document.getElementById('glbCampusViewer');
      const btn = document.getElementById('glbToggleBtn');
      if (isGlbModelActive) {
        canvas.style.display = 'none';
        glbViewer.style.display = 'block';
        btn.classList.add('bg-amber-500', 'text-slate-950', 'glow-gold');
        btn.classList.remove('bg-[#121B30]', 'text-amber-300');
        updateBanner("تم تفعيل عرض نموذج الحرم الجامعي الواقعي ثلاثي الأبعاد (college_campus.glb).");
        playTacticalBeep(950, 'sine', 0.08);
      } else {
        canvas.style.display = 'block';
        glbViewer.style.display = 'none';
        btn.classList.remove('bg-amber-500', 'text-slate-950', 'glow-gold');
        btn.classList.add('bg-[#121B30]', 'text-amber-300');
        updateBanner("تمت العودة إلى محرك الرادار التكتيكي ثلاثي الأبعاد.");
        resizeCampusCanvas();
        playTacticalBeep(800, 'sine', 0.05);
      }
    }

    /* ==============================================================
       CANVAS 2: FIRST-PERSON 3D INDOOR WALKTHROUGH ENGINE
       ============================================================== */
    const corridorCanvas = document.getElementById('corridorCanvas');
    const walkCtx = corridorCanvas.getContext('2d');
    let walkAnimFrameId = null;

    function resizeCorridorCanvas() {
      const rect = corridorCanvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      corridorCanvas.width = rect.width;
      corridorCanvas.height = rect.height;
      drawCorridorWalkthrough();
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCorridorCanvas);

    function drawCorridorWalkthrough() {
      if (!corridorCanvas.width || !corridorCanvas.height) return;
      const w = corridorCanvas.width;
      const h = corridorCanvas.height;
      const cx = w / 2 + corridorYaw * 60;
      const cy = h / 2;

      // Dark Tactical Ceiling & Floor
      walkCtx.fillStyle = '#060911';
      walkCtx.fillRect(0, 0, w, cy); // Ceiling
      walkCtx.fillStyle = '#090D18';
      walkCtx.fillRect(0, cy, w, h - cy); // Floor

      // Perspective Corridor Walls (Vanishing Point: cx, cy)
      const corridorW = w * 0.22;
      const corridorH = h * 0.32;

      // Left Wall
      walkCtx.fillStyle = '#0C1322';
      walkCtx.beginPath();
      walkCtx.moveTo(0, 0);
      walkCtx.lineTo(cx - corridorW, cy - corridorH);
      walkCtx.lineTo(cx - corridorW, cy + corridorH);
      walkCtx.lineTo(0, h);
      walkCtx.closePath();
      walkCtx.fill();
      walkCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25)';
      walkCtx.stroke();

      // Right Wall
      walkCtx.fillStyle = '#0E1729';
      walkCtx.beginPath();
      walkCtx.moveTo(w, 0);
      walkCtx.lineTo(cx + corridorW, cy - corridorH);
      walkCtx.lineTo(cx + corridorW, cy + corridorH);
      walkCtx.lineTo(w, h);
      walkCtx.closePath();
      walkCtx.fill();
      walkCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25)';
      walkCtx.stroke();

      // Back Wall at Vanishing Point
      walkCtx.fillStyle = '#070C16';
      walkCtx.fillRect(cx - corridorW, cy - corridorH, corridorW * 2, corridorH * 2);
      walkCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4)';
      walkCtx.strokeRect(cx - corridorW, cy - corridorH, corridorW * 2, corridorH * 2);

      // Wall Doorways along the corridor (Side Doors)
      drawWallDoor(walkCtx, 0.3, true, cx, cy, w, h, "#400", false);
      drawWallDoor(walkCtx, 0.65, true, cx, cy, w, h, "#401", false);
      drawWallDoor(walkCtx, 0.55, false, cx, cy, w, h, "#402", true); // Target Hall on right!

      // Flowing Neon Floor Guidance Ribbon / Arrows
      drawFloorLaserRibbon(walkCtx, cx, cy, w, h);

      // Recessed Ceiling Tactical LED Lights
      for (let z = 0.2; z <= 0.9; z += 0.22) {
        const topY = cy - corridorH * z - (1 - z) * (cy - corridorH);
        const lightW = (corridorW * z + (1 - z) * (w / 2)) * 0.4;
        walkCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25)';
        walkCtx.fillRect(cx - lightW / 2, topY, lightW, 3);
      }
    }

    function drawWallDoor(ctx, depthRatio, isLeft, cx, cy, w, h, doorLabel, isTarget) {
      const topY = cy - (h * 0.35) * (1 - depthRatio * 0.4);
      const botY = cy + (h * 0.35) * (1 - depthRatio * 0.4);
      const wallX = isLeft ? w * 0.15 * (1 - depthRatio) + (cx - w * 0.22) * depthRatio : w * 0.85 * (1 - depthRatio) + (cx + w * 0.22) * depthRatio;
      const doorW = 28 * (1 - depthRatio * 0.5);

      ctx.fillStyle = isTarget ? 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15)' : 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)';
      ctx.strokeStyle = isTarget ? '#00F0FF' : 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.6)';
      ctx.lineWidth = isTarget ? 2 : 1;

      const doorLeft = isLeft ? wallX : wallX - doorW;
      ctx.fillRect(doorLeft, topY + 15, doorW, botY - topY - 15);
      ctx.strokeRect(doorLeft, topY + 15, doorW, botY - topY - 15);

      // Glowing Door Label
      ctx.fillStyle = isTarget ? '#00F0FF' : '#94A3B8';
      ctx.font = isTarget ? 'bold 11px monospace' : '9px monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(doorLabel, doorLeft + doorW / 2, topY + 10);

      if (isTarget) {
        // Target Arrival Reticle Indicator
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#00FF85';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(doorLeft + doorW / 2, (topY + botY) / 2, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    function drawFloorLaserRibbon(ctx, cx, cy, w, h) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#00F0FF';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.shadowColor = '#00F0FF';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 10;

      // Ground centerline
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + h * 0.18);
      ctx.lineTo(w / 2, h);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Animated Chevron Arrows flowing forward
      const arrowCount = 5;
      for (let i = 0; i < arrowCount; i++) {
        const offset = (corridorProgress + i / arrowCount) % 1.0;
        const arrowY = cy + h * 0.18 + offset * (h - (cy + h * 0.18));
        const arrowW = 12 + offset * 32;

        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0, 240, 255, ${offset * 0.85})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2 + offset * 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(w / 2 - arrowW / 2, arrowY + 8);
        ctx.lineTo(w / 2, arrowY);
        ctx.lineTo(w / 2 + arrowW / 2, arrowY + 8);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    function updateWalkStepUI() {
      const step = activeHall.steps[currentStepIndex] || activeHall.steps[0];
      document.getElementById('currentStepNumber').textContent = step.index;
      document.getElementById('stepStageLabel').textContent = `المرحلة: ${step.stage}`;
      document.getElementById('stepInstructionText').textContent = step.instruction;
      
      // Update Step Sequence Chips
      const container = document.getElementById('stepsSequenceContainer');
      container.innerHTML = activeHall.steps.map((s, idx) => `
        <button onclick="jumpToWalkStep(${idx})" class="p-2 rounded-xl text-xs text-right border transition-all ${
          idx === currentStepIndex
            ? 'bg-cyan-950/80 border-cyan-400 text-cyan-300 glow-cyan'
            : idx < currentStepIndex
            ? 'bg-[#0E1526] border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400'
            : 'bg-[#0E1526] border-slate-800 text-slate-400'
        }">
          <div class="font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>خطوة ${s.index}</span>
            <span class="text-[10px] font-mono-tactical">${s.distance > 0 ? s.distance + 'م' : 'وصول'}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="text-[10px] truncate text-slate-300 mt-0.5">${s.stage}</div>
        </button>
      `).join('');

      drawCorridorWalkthrough();
    }

    function nextWalkStep() {
      if (currentStepIndex < activeHall.steps.length - 1) {
        currentStepIndex++;
        corridorProgress = 0;
        updateWalkStepUI();
        speakCurrentStepAudio();
        playTacticalBeep(920, 'sine', 0.06);
      } else {
        updateBanner("تهانينا! لقد وصلت إلى وجهتك المستهدفة بنجاح.");
        playTacticalBeep(1200, 'sine', 0.15);
      }
    }

    function prevWalkStep() {
      if (currentStepIndex > 0) {
        currentStepIndex--;
        corridorProgress = 0;
        updateWalkStepUI();
        speakCurrentStepAudio();
        playTacticalBeep(700, 'sine', 0.05);
      }
    }

    function jumpToWalkStep(idx) {
      currentStepIndex = idx;
      corridorProgress = 0;
      updateWalkStepUI();
      speakCurrentStepAudio();
      playTacticalBeep(850, 'sine', 0.05);
    }

    function toggleContinuousWalk() {
      isContinuousWalking = !isContinuousWalking;
      const btn = document.getElementById('walkSimBtn');
      const text = document.getElementById('walkSimBtnText');
      if (isContinuousWalking) {
        btn.classList.add('glow-emerald');
        text.textContent = "إيقاف محاكي المشي";
        walkIntervalId = setInterval(() => {
          corridorProgress += 0.04;
          if (corridorProgress >= 1.0) {
            corridorProgress = 0;
            if (currentStepIndex < activeHall.steps.length - 1) {
              currentStepIndex++;
              updateWalkStepUI();
              speakCurrentStepAudio();
            } else {
              toggleContinuousWalk();
            }
          }
          drawCorridorWalkthrough();
          playTacticalBeep(400, 'sine', 0.02); // Footstep audio simulation
        }, 80);
      } else {
        clearInterval(walkIntervalId);
        text.textContent = "تشغيل محاكي المشي المستمر";
      }
    }

    function toggleArMode() {
      isArMode = !isArMode;
      const overlay = document.getElementById('arOverlay');
      const btn = document.getElementById('arModeBtn');
      if (isArMode) {
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
        btn.classList.add('text-emerald-400', 'border-emerald-500/50');
        playTacticalBeep(980, 'sine', 0.08);
      } else {
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
        btn.classList.remove('text-emerald-400', 'border-emerald-500/50');
      }
    }

    function speakCurrentStepAudio() {
      const step = activeHall.steps[currentStepIndex] || activeHall.steps[0];
      speakArabicText(step.voice);
    }

    /* ==============================================================
       SCREEN 2: DIRECTORY RENDERING & BOOKING
       ============================================================== */
    let currentDirCategory = 'ALL';

    function renderHallsDirectory() {
      const container = document.getElementById('hallsContainer');
      const query = document.getElementById('dirSearchInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();

      const filtered = CAMPUS_HALLS.filter(hall => {
        const matchesCat = currentDirCategory === 'ALL' || hall.category === currentDirCategory;
        const matchesQuery = !query || 
          hall.raw.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
          hall.official.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
          hall.topic.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          hall.speaker.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        return matchesCat && matchesQuery;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="col-span-full py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-search text-3xl mb-2 text-slate-600"></i>
            <p>لا توجد قاعات مطابقة لبحثك</p>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = filtered.map(hall => {
        const isBooked = bookedHallCodes.has(hall.code);
        return `
          <div class="bg-[#0E1526] border ${hall.code === activeHall.code ? 'border-cyan-400 glow-cyan' : 'border-slate-800'} rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all hover:border-cyan-500/50 shadow-lg">
            
            <div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <span class="bg-cyan-950 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 font-mono-tactical font-bold text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                  ${hall.code}
                </span>
                <span class="text-[11px] ${hall.available ? 'text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/30' : 'text-amber-400 bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-500/30'} px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium">
                  ${isBooked ? 'محجوزة لك ✓' : hall.statusText}
                </span>
              </div>

              <h4 class="font-bold text-white text-sm mb-1">${hall.official}</h4>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-2">${hall.buildingName} • ${hall.floorLabel}</p>

              <div class="bg-[#121929] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs space-y-1 mb-3">
                <div class="text-slate-300 font-medium truncate"><i class="fa-solid fa-chalkboard-user text-cyan-400 ml-1.5"></i>${hall.speaker}</div>
                <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate"><i class="fa-solid fa-bookmark text-slate-500 ml-1.5"></i>${hall.topic}</div>
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                  <span>السعة: ${hall.capacity}</span>
                  <span class="font-mono-tactical text-emerald-400">BEACON: ${hall.beacon}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Actions Row -->
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800">
              <button onclick="bookHall('${hall.code}')" class="flex-1 ${isBooked ? 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500' : 'bg-[#141C30] hover:bg-[#1C2742] text-slate-300 border border-slate-700'} py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-all">
                ${isBooked ? 'إلغاء الحجز' : 'حجز القاعة'}
              </button>

              <button onclick="speakArabicText('${hall.official}، القاعة رقم ${hall.raw} في ${hall.buildingName}')" class="bg-[#141C30] hover:bg-cyan-950 text-slate-400 hover:text-cyan-400 w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-sm transition-all" title="استماع">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i>
              </button>

              <button onclick="launchAerialDropForHall('${hall.code}')" class="bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs glow-cyan transition-all flex items-center gap-1">
                <span>هبوط وملاحة</span>
                <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left text-[10px]"></i>
              </button>
            </div>

          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function setDirCategory(cat) {
      currentDirCategory = cat;
      document.querySelectorAll('.dir-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-slate-950', 'font-bold'));
      event.target.classList.add('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-slate-950', 'font-bold');
      renderHallsDirectory();
      playTacticalBeep(700, 'sine', 0.04);
    }

    function filterHalls() {
      renderHallsDirectory();
    }

    function bookHall(code) {
      if (bookedHallCodes.has(code)) {
        bookedHallCodes.delete(code);
        updateBanner(`تم إلغاء حجز القاعة ${code}.`);
      } else {
        bookedHallCodes.add(code);
        updateBanner(`تم تأكيد حجزك للقاعة ${code} بنجاح. شارة الحجز نشطة.`);
        playTacticalBeep(1000, 'sine', 0.1);
      }
      renderHallsDirectory();
    }

    /* ==============================================================
       CINEMATIC AERIAL DROP MODAL SIMULATION
       ============================================================== */
    function launchAerialDropForCurrentBuilding() {
      // Find default hall in current building
      const hall = CAMPUS_HALLS.find(h => h.buildingId === currentBuilding.id) || CAMPUS_HALLS[0];
      launchAerialDropForHall(hall.code);
    }

    function launchAerialDropForHall(code) {
      activeHall = CAMPUS_HALLS.find(h => h.code === code) || CAMPUS_HALLS[0];
      currentBuilding = CAMPUS_BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === activeHall.buildingId) || CAMPUS_BUILDINGS[0];

      // Update walkthrough UI with target hall
      document.getElementById('walkHallCodeBadge').textContent = activeHall.code;
      document.getElementById('walkHallTitle').textContent = activeHall.official;
      document.getElementById('walkFloorBadge').textContent = activeHall.floorLabel;
      document.getElementById('walkBuildingName').textContent = activeHall.buildingName;
      currentStepIndex = 0;
      corridorProgress = 0;
      updateWalkStepUI();

      // Setup Aerial Modal
      document.getElementById('aerialTargetTitle').textContent = `${activeHall.official} (${activeHall.code})`;
      document.getElementById('aerialTargetBuilding').textContent = `${activeHall.buildingName} (${activeHall.floorLabel})`;
      document.getElementById('aerialDropModal').classList.remove('hidden');

      aerialAltitude = 280;
      playTacticalBeep(600, 'sawtooth', 0.12);

      clearInterval(aerialIntervalId);
      aerialIntervalId = setInterval(() => {
        aerialAltitude -= 22;
        if (aerialAltitude <= 12) {
          aerialAltitude = 12;
          document.getElementById('aerialAltitudeNum').textContent = aerialAltitude;
          clearInterval(aerialIntervalId);
          setTimeout(() => {
            skipAerialDrop();
          }, 400);
        } else {
          document.getElementById('aerialAltitudeNum').textContent = aerialAltitude;
          playTacticalBeep(700 + (280 - aerialAltitude) * 2, 'sine', 0.03);
        }
      }, 90);
    }

    function skipAerialDrop() {
      clearInterval(aerialIntervalId);
      document.getElementById('aerialDropModal').classList.add('hidden');
      switchTab('screen-walkthrough', document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab')[2]);
      updateBanner(`وصلت إلى موقع الهدف: ${activeHall.official}. اتبع مسار الملاحة الداخلي.`);
      speakCurrentStepAudio();
      playTacticalBeep(1100, 'sine', 0.12);
    }

    /* ==============================================================
       SCREEN 4: AI TACTICAL ASSISTANT
       ============================================================== */
    let currentAiMode = 'FAST_SEARCH';

    function setAiMode(mode) {
      currentAiMode = mode;
      document.querySelectorAll('.ai-mode-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active', 'bg-cyan-500/20', 'border-cyan-500/40', 'text-cyan-300'));
      event.currentTarget.classList.add('active', 'bg-cyan-500/20', 'border-cyan-500/40', 'text-cyan-300');
      playTacticalBeep(750, 'sine', 0.04);
    }

    function handleAiInputKey(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        sendUserAiMessage();
      }
    }

    function sendQuickPrompt(prompt) {
      document.getElementById('aiUserInput').value = prompt;
      sendUserAiMessage();
    }

    function simulateVoiceInput() {
      playTacticalBeep(900, 'sine', 0.08);
      document.getElementById('aiUserInput').value = "أين تقع قاعة المؤتمرات 402؟";
      setTimeout(sendUserAiMessage, 300);
    }

    function sendUserAiMessage() {
      const input = document.getElementById('aiUserInput');
      const text = input.value.trim();
      if (!text) return;

      appendChatMessage(text, true);
      input.value = '';
      playTacticalBeep(850, 'sine', 0.05);

      // Assistant Thinking Simulation
      setTimeout(() => {
        let reply = "";
        let targetCode = null;

        if (text.includes('402') || text.includes('صالح الفهد') || text.includes('مؤتمرات')) {
          reply = "قاعة الشيخ صالح الفهد للمؤتمرات (#402) تقع في مبنى 1، الدور الرابع. تتسع لـ 250 شخصاً ومزودة بمصعد بانورامي. يمكنك النقر على زر 'هبوط وملاحة' للبدء فوراً.";
          targetCode = "#402";
        } else if (text.includes('315') || text.includes('سيبراني') || text.includes('حاسب')) {
          reply = "معمل الأمن السيبراني والتحقيق الجنائي الرقمي (#315) يقع في مبنى 2، الدور الثالث. المعمل متاح الآن ويضم 45 محطة حوسبة متقدمة.";
          targetCode = "#315";
        } else if (text.includes('كراسي') || text.includes('معاقين') || text.includes('احتياجات')) {
          reply = "جميع مباني الحرم الجامعي الـ 12 مزودة بمسارات كراسي متحركة خالية من العوائق، ومصاعد كهربائية ناطقة، ومنحدرات مطابقة لكود البناء السعودي. تم تفعيل مسار الكراسي المتحركة المضاء بالأخضر في الخريطة.";
        } else {
          reply = `بناءً على قاعدة بيانات الحرم الجامعي: يمكنك الوصول إلى وجهتك بسهولة عبر البوابات الرئيسية. النظام يوفر دقة تموضع تصل إلى ±0.35م عبر مستشعرات UWB. هل تود أن أحدد لك أقرب مسار؟`;
        }

        appendChatMessage(reply, false, targetCode);
        speakArabicText(reply);
        playTacticalBeep(1050, 'sine', 0.08);
      }, 500);
    }

    function appendChatMessage(text, isUser, targetCode = null) {
      const chat = document.getElementById('chatHistory');
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = `flex items-start gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl max-w-[85%] ${
        isUser
          ? 'bg-cyan-950/70 border border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-100 self-end'
          : 'bg-[#10172B] border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 self-start'
      }`;

      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg ${isUser ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950' : 'bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30'} flex items-center justify-center text-xs shrink-0 font-bold">
          <i class="fa-solid ${isUser ? 'fa-user' : 'fa-robot'}"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <span class="font-bold text-white text-xs">${isUser ? 'أنت' : 'المساعد التكتيكي (Gemini 3.8 Flash)'}</span>
          </div>
          <p class="text-xs leading-relaxed">${text}</p>
          ${targetCode ? `
            <button onclick="launchAerialDropForHall('${targetCode}')" class="mt-2.5 bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs glow-cyan transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-location-arrow text-[10px]"></i>
              <span>بدء الملاحة إلى ${targetCode}</span>
            </button>
          ` : ''}
        </div>
      `;

      chat.appendChild(div);
      chat.scrollTop = chat.scrollHeight;
    }

    /* ==============================================================
       MODALS & UTILITIES
       ============================================================== */
    function toggleRadarModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('radarModal');
      modal.classList.toggle('hidden');
      playTacticalBeep(800, 'sine', 0.06);
    }

    function simulateRadarLock() {
      playTacticalBeep(1150, 'sawtooth', 0.1);
      updateBanner("تم قفل الرادار التكتيكي على الهدف بنجاح: دقة UWB ±0.35m");
      toggleRadarModal();
    }

    function toggleVoiceMute() {
      isVoiceMuted = !isVoiceMuted;
      const btn = document.getElementById('muteBtn');
      if (isVoiceMuted) {
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-volume-xmark text-red-400"></i>';
        window.speechSynthesis?.cancel();
      } else {
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high text-cyan-300"></i>';
        playTacticalBeep(900, 'sine', 0.05);
      }
    }

    function updateBanner(msg) {
      document.getElementById('bannerMessage').textContent = msg;
      document.getElementById('statusBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function dismissBanner() {
      document.getElementById('statusBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function switchTab(screenId, btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.screen-view').forEach(s => s.classList.add('hidden'));
      document.getElementById(screenId).classList.remove('hidden');

      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('active', 'text-cyan-400');
        t.classList.add('text-slate-400');
      });
      btn.classList.add('active', 'text-cyan-400');
      btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400');

      playTacticalBeep(650, 'sine', 0.04);

      if (screenId === 'screen-campus3d') {
        setTimeout(resizeCampusCanvas, 30);
      } else if (screenId === 'screen-walkthrough') {
        setTimeout(resizeCorridorCanvas, 30);
      } else if (screenId === 'screen-directory') {
        renderHallsDirectory();
      }
    }

    /* INITIALIZATION ON LOAD */
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      resizeCampusCanvas();
      resizeCorridorCanvas();
      renderHallsDirectory();
      updateWalkStepUI();
      updateCompassHeading();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
